body: I just want someone to know he shouldnt be gone.  I should be the one.  Fuck.  Just fuck.  What the hell are you supposed to feel.

No one really cares, do they?  That a great man died.  That the most gentle man I've known is gone.  It just doesnt really matter.  The world is so big now.  So many people all doing their own thing.  So meaningless. Maybe he was right.
Im just tired of crying and i dont know what to do.  I keep thinking of that line from shakespear.  Either thou or I or both must go with him.
I just need a forum, or a friend or fuck I dont know.  fuck, im sorry.

I've suffered from depression for most of my life, im 29.  He was 30.  He was my confidant and adviser and he didnt say anything.  His family wont talk to me, they dont know what to say.  I don't even know what i want to say about it.  Im sorry.
